facts.text: Park Hyatt Suzhou is a contemporary version of a traditional Suzhou manor.
facts.excerpt: Stay in a contemporary version of a traditional Suzhou manor while exploring a city steeped in over 2,500 years of history.

facts.text: The rooms use a blue-green palette inspired by the colors of Lake Tai.
facts.excerpt: elegant rooms in a serene blue-green palette inspired by the beautiful colors of Lake Tai

facts.text: The rooms have Asian-inspired details including brush-ink printed screens and crabapple-shaped mirrors.

facts.text: Standard rooms have a semi-private 'pavilion' with living and dining or study areas.

facts.text: Garden view rooms look out over Japanese pine and a koi fishpond.

facts.text: Lake view rooms have views of Jinji Lake and a marble bathroom with a deep-soaking tub and rainforest shower.

facts.text: The Presidential Suite includes a karaoke room and personalized butler service.
